sentences.text: Learned counsel for petitioner submits that land of the petitioner was acquired by respondent No.2, accordingly award was also passed by the Land Acquisition Officer.

Petitioner challenged the award before the Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Tribunal, Chhattisgarh seeking enhancement of the compensation as also the interest on the calculated amount of compensation.

entities.text: Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Tribunal, Chhattisgarh
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Claim of petitioner for enhancement of compensation was rejected, however, the Tribunal has allowed the reference of petitioner to the extent that petitioner is entitled for interest in accordance with the provisions of The Right To Fair Compensation And Transparency In Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation And Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text:
Right To Fair Compensation And Transparency In Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation And Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Pursuant to the order passed by the Tribunal, Land Acquisition Officer has computed the interest and has forwarded the same to the respondent No.2 and reminder letter was also issued on 22.12.2023, however, till date the interest for which petitioner is entitled has not been disbursed and therefore, a direction be issued to respondent No.2 to disburse the amount of interest which she is entitled at the earliest within specified time.
3. Learned counsel for respondent No.2 submits that he has received instructions on the ground raised in the writ petition.

He do not dispute the submission of learned counsel for petitioner Neutral Citation 2024:CGHC:25625 that Land Acquisition Officer after computing the interest has forwarded the total amount of interest to be paid to petitioner on the date of its computation and as per his instruction, respondent No.2 is in process of making payment of the amount of interest to the petitioner and it will be paid within the shortest possible time.
4. Learned State counsel submits that grievance of petitioner is against respondent No.2 as respondent No.3 has already computed the interest as per order passed by the Tribunal.

5. Taking into consideration the facts and circumstances of the case, submission of learned counsel for respective parties and further undisputed fact that petitioner is held entitled for the interest in the reference proceedings initiated before Tribunal and further that respondent No.2 is already taking necessary steps for making payment of interest to the petitioner, this petition is disposed off at this stage directing respondent No.2 to pay the amount of interest as ordered by the Tribunal in the reference proceeding in favour of the petitioner at the earliest preferably within period of six weeks from the date of receipt of order.
6. Accordingly, this petition is disposed of with the aforesaid observations and directions.
